title: Assertion
description: A single check run against a step's result after it executes, dispatched by 'matcher' name to a registered Maestro.Assert.Matcher implementation. Referenced from step.schema.json and scenario.schema.json so both share one definition.

matcher.description: Name of the registered assertion matcher (see Maestro.Assert.Registry) that interprets this entry and performs the check. Defaults to "json_match" if omitted.

path.description: json_match-specific: path into the step's response to check (e.g. "$.total"). If omitted, the whole response is checked. Other matchers may ignore this field or give it their own meaning.

expected.description: The expected value/shape to check against (or matcher-specific check configuration). May reference the step's resolved dataset/saved state via interpolation (e.g. "{{order_id}}").
